_comment: The answers the catalog seed cannot give, maintained by hand.
worker/scripts/ knows what an ingredient is, how it is stored, what
opening does to it and who delivers it. It does not know any of the
following, and nothing in the repository does:
allergens      What a person has determined an item declares. Deliberately
empty rather than guessed: an allergen line is a compliance
statement, and inferring one from an ingredient's name is
exactly the error that makes a label worse than no label.
An item absent from this map prints 'Not recorded' and can
still be typed into the form for a one-off print. The two
entries present were transcribed from the existing artwork
in ../tonkotsu-packet.zpl and ../sauce-packet.zpl, not
derived.
products       Per finished product: the name as it appears on the label
(the catalog holds 'Tonkotsu Broth', the label says 'M&R
Tonkotsu Broth'), whether it carries the oval health mark,
and the customer SKU and pack quantity for the packet and
the case. Only the three products that already exist as
artwork are filled in. The rest are typed into the form
until somebody fills them in here.
health_mark is null in the catalog for every product, meaning not yet
determined rather than no mark, so it is stated per product here and
never defaulted.
